Each committed step is one undo entry. External revision changes stop the plan; cancellation retains completed work. Plans do not start speaker playback. New patches use engine v2 with named outputs and polyphonic cables. Build a patch, analyze_signal or capture_signal any output, then render_audio. capture_signal returns calibrated min/max waveform bins offline from reset, not live audio. audio_stereo selects stereo WAV export; other outputs use the first channel. Add poly_sum for a mono mix. Optional sorted sample-frame midi_events and module_events drive reproducible performances during render_audio, analyze_signal, and capture_signal without modifying the patch. trigger_module is unsupported without a live audio backend; inspect_performance reports that boundary. rotate_sequence commits one undoable seq3 column rotation. initialize_modules restores eligible defaults with audited per-kind initialization; randomize_modules requires a u32 seed and follows catalog eligibility/distributions. Both support atomic batches and preview; undo/redo restore saved controls and captured persistent state. capture_module_preset snapshots effective controls/current persistent state; save_module_preset writes exactly reviewed contents to a new .opreset file. Browse with list_module_presets/read_module_preset and apply reviewed inline contents with apply_module_preset; loading does not Initialize or replace the module. Filenames are confined to the configured workspace; existing files are never overwritten. This headless process owns an independent patch. bypass.compatibility: explicit OpenPatch host policy; generic utility/filter routes are chosen for existing OpenPatch kinds, not a claim of full Rack bypass parity

modules.clock_policy: shared f32 elapsed timer advances only when clock connected; scalar Schmitt starts uninitialized, thresholds 0.1/2 V; first high arms without edge; low-to-high measures 1/elapsed including first acquisition since construction; timer resets at every rising edge even if measured rate outside 0.001..1000 Hz; disconnected clock sets frequency2 and freezes timer/detector
modules.description: Unfiltered wavetable modulation with linear point/wave interpolation, exponential FM, shared clock-rate measurement, reset, invert and offset. Advance phase, apply reset, then emit.
modules.frequency_policy: clock_frequency / 2 × exp2(rate + rawFM × amount), capped at1024 Hz; invert waveform, add1 when offset on, then multiply by5 V
modules.initialize_policy: whole-module initialize zeros phases/timer and sets clock frequency to 1, preserving reset/clock detector histories and lights; caller separately initializes table and parameters
modules.light_policy: publish every 16 samples; source signed brightness with immediate rise and 30/s decay; mono phase lights or poly blue, then two mode lights; bypass freezes divider and light state

rate.description: Unpatched: 2^rate Hz. Patched clock: clock frequency × 2^rate / 2

modules.position_policy: clamp(position + positionCV × position_cv_amount / 10, 0, 1); crossfade complete waves; normalized CV-influenced position is observable; partial final wave is retained but not played
modules.reset_policy: SIMD-style Schmitt starts high; rescale reset from0.1..2 V to0..1 before comparison; first high never triggers until a low was observed; active padded groups advance then reset phase to0 before lookup; initialize preserves detectors
modules.state_adoption: same sample rate and model copies bounded runtime only; receiving parameters and immutable bank stay in place; source changes preserve detector histories
modules.suspended_table_policy: loading or invalid table emits zero at the connected voice width; phases, reset/sync detectors and correction queues freeze; LFO clock measurement and light divider continue

edge_policy.flip_flop: FLOP toggles on each IN rise; FLIP is complement; RESET forces FLOP low

length_policy.gate: on IN rise set integer age to zero; increment age before testing age >= duration * sample_rate; expiry stays off until next IN rise; current LENGTH applies every active sample

baseline.raw_jsonl: {"id":1,"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"capabilities":{"tools":{}},"instructions":"OpenPatch is an offline modular synthesizer. Start with catalog and inspect_patch. Notes and Blank use typed module content; set_module_content edits it atomically with the shared revision/history path. For visible construction, start_construction preflights a bounded plan and commits paced steps; inspect_construction reports progress, and pause_construction/resume_construction/cancel_construction control future steps. Each committed step is one undo entry. External revision changes stop the plan; cancellation retains completed work. Plans do not start speaker playback. New patches use engine v2 with named outputs and polyphonic cables. Build a patch, analyze_signal or capture_signal any output, then render_audio. capture_signal returns calibrated min/max waveform bins offline from reset, not live audio. audio_stereo selects stereo WAV export; other outputs use the first channel. Add poly_sum for a mono mix. Optional sorted sample-frame midi_events and module_events drive reproducible performances during render_audio, analyze_signal, and capture_signal without modifying the patch. trigger_module is unsupported without a live audio backend; inspect_performance reports that boundary. rotate_sequence commits one undoable seq3 column rotation. initialize_modules restores eligible defaults with audited per-kind initialization; randomize_modules requires a u32 seed and follows catalog eligibility/distributions. Both support atomic batches and preview; undo/redo restore saved controls and captured persistent state. capture_module_preset snapshots effective controls/current persistent state; save_module_preset writes exactly reviewed contents to a new .opreset file. Browse with list_module_presets/read_module_preset and apply reviewed inline contents with apply_module_preset; loading does not Initialize or replace the module. Filenames are confined to the configured workspace; existing files are never overwritten. This headless process owns an independent patch. No speaker playback or VCV plugin compatibility.","protocolVersion":"2025-11-25","serverInfo":{"name":"openpatch","version":"0.1.0"}}}
